title: selaginella australiensis var. leptostachya
intro: Selaginella australiensis var. leptostachya, commonly known as the Australian spikemoss, is a species of spikemoss that belongs to the family Selaginellaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Selaginella australiensis var. leptostachya are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to possess anti-proliferative and pro-apoptotic effects. Further research is needed to fully understand the health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant, but it has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various ailments.
